description: Box 3 tax on savings and investments in the Netherlands for 2026 (the notional-return system): the tax-free allowance, the notional return on savings, investments and debts, and the 36% tax. Optionally for fiscal partners (double allowance). With a country and property or savings abroad (an expat's home country), also the treaty relief: the property is exempt, tax withheld abroad is credited.

country.description: For assets in another country (2-letter code, e.g. IN, GB, DE, PL): the country, for the treaty relief. Leave out when everything is in the Netherlands.

debts.description: Debts in Box 3 on 1 January (not the mortgage on your own home), euros

fiscal_partner.description: Filing together with a fiscal partner (amounts are the couple's total). Default false.

investments.description: Investments and other assets (shares, crypto, a second home) on 1 January, euros

other_assets_abroad.description: Savings and investments in that country on 1 January, euros. Not included in savings or investments. Taxed here; tax withheld there is credited.

property_abroad.description: Value of a home or land in that country on 1 January (your share), euros. Not included in investments. Exempt from Dutch Box 3 under the treaty, but it still counts for spreading the tax-free allowance.

savings.description: Bank and savings balances on 1 January, euros

tax_withheld_abroad.description: Tax already withheld in that country on those other assets (interest, dividends) for the year, euros.

name: box3_wealth_tax
title: Dutch Box 3 wealth tax
